description:
As a customer, I want to search so I can find a tool quickly.

* A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
* A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
* Search is case-insensitive.
* Clearing the search restores the full product list.

Search matches product names (partial, case-insensitive)

criteria.text: A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
Clearing the search restores the full product list.

cases.title: Search term matching existing products lists only matching products
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <at least two products whose names contain a common term> and <at least one product whose name does not contain that term>.
steps: Enter <a term contained in the names of the matching products> in the search field.
cases.expected: Only the products whose names contain the search term are listed; the non-matching product(s) are not shown.

cases.title: Search term with no matches shows an empty state message
cases.preconditions: The product list contains products, none of whose names contain <a term that matches no product name>.
steps: Enter <a term that matches no product name> in the search field.
cases.expected: No products are listed and an empty state message is displayed (exact text not specified in the story). No error is shown.

cases.title: Search is case-insensitive
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <a product whose name contains both upper- and lower-case letters>.
steps: Enter <the product name term in all lower case> in the search field and run the search.
Clear the search field and enter <the same term in all upper case>, then run the search.
cases.expected: Both searches return the same result set, including <the product whose name contains the term>, regardless of the letter case used.

cases.title: Partial product name term returns the matching products
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <a product whose name contains a term as a fragment, not from the start of the name>.
steps: Enter <a fragment of that product's name> in the search field.
cases.expected: The product whose name contains that fragment is listed; products whose names do not contain the fragment are not listed.

cases.title: Clearing the search restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <several products with different names>.
steps: Open the product list and note the full list of products shown.
Enter <a term matching only some of the products> in the search field and run the search.
cases.expected: The full product list is shown again, identical to the list noted in step 1.

cases.title: Clearing the search after a no-match term restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <several products with different names>.
steps: Open the product list and note the full list of products shown.
Enter <a term that matches no product name> in the search field and run the search.
cases.expected: After clearing, the full product list is shown again, identical to the list noted in step 1, with no error.
